old: A 1981 Swiss 2-franc coin. The front shows Helvetia, the figure of Switzerland, standing with a spear and shield; the back shows the value inside a wreath of oak and alpine flowers. Designed by Albert Walch (front) and Friedrich Fisch (back), engraved by Antoine Bovy, and struck in copper-nickel (75% copper, 25% nickel).
